claimsReviewed: Docker Desktop bind xattr ENOTSUP is qualified to the tested profile; a new named Linux volume avoids that failure without moving populated Storage to empty backing.
Persistent RESTORE_OVERRIDE joins runner override in every installed Compose context; byte backup must match bind versus named-volume profile.
Cold backup discovers actual Storage volume, archives stopped bytes separately with ownership/ACLs/xattrs, and covers neither S3 nor provider backend.
Target root introduction preserves all existing encryption credentials, rejects invalid saved root, keeps writes0600 and never equates key presence with content encryption.
readOnlyComposeMergeProbe: Actual docker compose config using synthetic base/override confirms only /var/lib/storage binding is replaced by named volume while unrelated read-only binding and service remain. No containers or volumes created.
